Maya L: FYI I'm putting in my resignation. Last working day will be 2026-06-15. I'm on a H1-B and have an ongoing relocation package question. Also enrolled in global benefits (UK plan) and have RSU cliff coming up.
Ishaan K: Sorry to hear that, Maya. Thanks for the heads up. Can you confirm your email and if you have any planned PTO? I'll coordinate handoff.
Maya L: maya.l@redwood.com, no PTO. Have two client-facing dashboards scheduled for next week, will try to freeze them.
People Ops: Thanks, Maya. A few notes: 1) For international employees we typically end benefits on the actual last day of employment (not month-end) depending on local regs; Legal will confirm. 2) COBRA doesn't apply outside the US; we'll provide local exit benefits packet and UK enrollment termination timeline. 3) We'll schedule a 30m exit interview — propose 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-12 at 11:00 GMT.
Legal: Confirmed — for UK-plan participants benefits terminate on last day of employment unless otherwise required. We'll DM details about the relocation repayment schedule and equity cliff.
Maya L: About RSUs: I believe there's a pro-rata vesting policy for departures before cliff? Need confirmation.
People Ops: We'll pull your equity record and send the vesting/accelerations summary. If you have questions about exercising after termination we'll include contact for StockOps.
Ishaan K: On handoff: please make a short checklist of runbooks for the dashboards and tag the shared runbook with an owner. I'll cover client comms. Also flag any scheduled migrations.
IT Ops: For access we'll do phased deprovision: network and SSO on last business day EOD, but we can revoke prod API keys earlier if needed. Please list service accounts you own. If you have personal keys in vault, mark them for transfer. Asset pickup: Facilities can schedule a courier drop-off or you can drop at HQ.
Facilities: We can arrange courier pickup week of 2026-06-15. If you prefer drop-off, sign up here: https://redwood.internal/facilities/returns.
Maya L: I have two SSH keys deployed to staging and one API token for a client integration in prod. Also have company laptop tag RDW-5590 serial S/N UK7-LAP-22.
IT Ops: Noted. Proposed ops before 2026-06-15 EOD:
```
# revoke prod integration token and rotate
secretsmgr rotate --service client-int --user maya.l@redwood.com
# export list of infra ownership
infra-owner-export --by-user maya.l@redwood.com > /tmp/maya-owners.csv
# SSH authorized_keys cleanup on staging-hosts
for host in staging-*; do ssh admin@$host "sed -i '/maya.l/d' /home/*/.ssh/authorized_keys"; done
```
Also creating ticket IT-8019 for laptop return and key rotation.
Payroll Bot: Final salary will be included in the 2026-06-30 payroll cycle. Any outstanding expenses must be submitted by 2026-06-20. Relocation clawback review will be processed by Legal and Payroll; we'll notify if any deductions apply.
People Ops: We'll send local benefits termination packet and equity summary by EOD today. Exit interview invites created for 2026-06-10 11:00 GMT (30m) and 2026-06-12 11:00 GMT. Please accept one.
Maya L: Thanks. Can you also archive my slack DMs with external vendor? I need a copy for immigration.
Legal: We can prepare an attestation letter and archive export. Use the export request form: https://redwood.internal/legal/exports. We'll fast-track for visa docs.
Ishaan K: I'll work with Maya to freeze the client dashboards and create a short runbook. Maya, can you add a note in the repo at /oncall/runbooks/maya-dashboards.md?
Maya L: Will do. I'll also add a short list of pending PRs and any follow-ups.
People Ops: Offboarding checklist created: https://redwood.internal/offboard/1993501234 (status: 2/6). Items: benefits termination, asset return, exit interview, payroll notification, legal review, access deprovision.
IT Ops: We'll wait for Ishaan sign-off before SSO disable. After disable we'll run an org audit: `org-audit --user maya.l@redwood.com --format csv > /tmp/maya-audit.csv` and attach to ticket.
Facilities: Courier scheduled for pickup 2026-06-16 AM unless Maya opts to drop.
Maya L: Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick turnaround on the equity and relocation notes. I'll accept the 6/10 slot.
People Ops: Closing loop once all items complete. Keeping thread open until final payroll confirmation and asset ticket closed. :handshake:
